tags.description:en: Next to a hospital, this informal hotel is a kilometer from Old Town, 3 km from the Przystanek PKP Szczecin Msciecino train station and 18 km from the restored 15th-century Ducal Castle.Airy, unfussy rooms have Wi-Fi access and satellite TV.
